scoring_justification: Checker recomputes critical interactions and residual entropies from the raw CSV produced by the agent’s SFA simulation.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold critical U values and residual entropies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text and Fig. 1: Metal→OSM at U≈2.8 (V1→0), OSM→MI at U>3.4 (V2→0); S/L=log2 in OSM, log3 in MI.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken from paper’s explicit statements and cross-checked with the hidden reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own reported quantities, not fabricated.

outputs.description: Extracted zero-temperature critical interactions and residual entropies.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes critical interactions and entropies from the raw CSV and compares to paper-reported values. Finite‑T and global‑J stages are beyond the minimal core per the approved taskability scope.
